resources.string: Alerts sound like any other messenger. Change or silence them in Android\'s notification settings — Rún never overrides your choice.
Couldn\'t register for notifications. Check your connection and try again.
No notification distributor was selected. Install ntfy from F-Droid, then try again.
Couldn\'t connect to your notification distributor. Close Rún fully and reopen it, then try again.
This distributor\'s push server isn\'t supported yet — it requires VAPID. ntfy works; you can install it from F-Droid.
Your notification distributor refused the registration. Open it, check it\'s set up, and try again.
Your notification distributor didn\'t respond in time. Open it, make sure it\'s connected, and try again.
This phone has no Google services, so notifications need a UnifiedPush distributor app. Install one — ntfy is the recommended choice — then come back here and turn notifications on.
Your notification distributor stopped delivering to Rún, so notifications were turned off. Turn them back on to reconnect.
Rún needs to restart to switch the app\'s language to %1$s. Continue?

Send anonymous diagnostic logs to the relay to help development. The logs never include anything that identifies you or this device: no names, no message content, no addresses, no keys, no inbox or contact ids.
Debug mode is on. Turn it off to stop sending anonymous diagnostic logs.

Send all relay traffic through a SOCKS5 proxy you run, such as Orbot or Tor on your own network, instead of Rún\'s built-in Tor. While this is on, the built-in Tor never starts. If the proxy can\'t be reached, Rún stays offline. It never falls back.
Enter an IP address on this phone or your local network: 127.x.x.x, ::1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16–31.x.x, 192.168.x.x or 169.254.x.x. Host names aren\'t allowed.
Couldn\'t save the setting. Try again.

Traffic between this phone and the proxy is not encrypted. Anyone who can watch or impersonate this address, including on other networks this phone joins later, gets the access tokens to your conversation inboxes. They could delete or take over those inboxes, but can\'t read your messages. Use this only on a network you control, and turn the mode off when you leave it.
While the proxy app (such as Orbot) isn\'t running, any other app on this phone can take its port and receive the same access tokens. Set the proxy app to a non-default port and keep it running.
Changes take effect the next time you open Rún.
Saved. Close and reopen Rún to apply it.
External proxy setting is invalid. Fix it in Settings.
External proxy setting couldn\'t be read. Messaging is unavailable.
What happened, and what did you expect?
Couldn\'t send the report — check the connection and try again.
Thank you for helping to improve Rún
